newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 2.73 million barrels in the week ended Dec 27 to 295.60 million barrels from 292.87 million barrels in the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Thursday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 1.55 million barrels in the week to 232.47 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 2.47 million barrels to 123.80 million from 121.33 million the previous week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 1.54 million barrels to 47.81 million barrels.
API said gasoline production rose 224,000 barrels in the week to 7.81 million bpd from 7.59 million.
Gasoline stocks fell 219,000 barrels in the week to 191.75 million barrels from 191.97 million barrels.
Percent of stocks capacity fell to 92.3 percent in the week from 93.3 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 463,000 barrels to 36.69 million barrels from 36.23 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units fell to 14.09 million barrels from 14.21 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 42.46 million barrels from 43.54 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports rose to 7.56 million barrels per day from 7.25 million, API said.
